messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: How does pre-market trading work?\nassistant: Pre-market trading takes place before the regular trading hours of the stock market, typically from 4:00 AM to 9:30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During this time, actual buyers and sellers participate in the market and get their orders matched. However, not all brokers allow trading during pre-market hours, and those that do may only allow limit orders to be placed, rather than market orders. This is because liquidity is usually much lower during pre-market hours, and using market orders could result in trades being filled at undesirable prices. Some brokers also require traders to specify that they want their orders to be executed during pre-market hours. If a trader places a limit order while specifying that they want it to be executed during pre-market hours, the trade can be executed in real-time at the specified price.\nuser: Is pre-market trading riskier than regular market?\nassistant: Yes. Pre-market trading can potentially be riskier than regular market trading due to liquidity that is very low. If an \"\"unexpected world events\"\" occurs, the volume/liquidity will most certainly increase.\nuser: Forex market, profitable?\nassistant: The Forex market, like any market, is directed by the law of supply and demand. It is more liquid, more easy to identify what makes the currency change and to \"\"predict\"\" it.  However, making a profit in the Forex market is extremely difficult and complex for both retail and institutional investors.  Binary options trading is one alternative that enables traders who have experienced difficulty in the Forex market to trade options.\nuser: What do you mean by binary options?",
    "answer": "Binary options involve taking a yes-or-no position on the price of an underlying asset. The payoff is described as “all or nothing”: a correct prediction earns a payout, while an incorrect prediction can mean losing all or almost all of the amount wagered. [S1][S2]\n\nThey often involve bets on very short-term market movements, sometimes measured in minutes. The supplied document characterizes them as gambling rather than investing, with a built-in advantage for the provider—not an easy or reliable way to make money. [S2]"
}
